macros.name: bigfoottolerance
macros.doc: This specifies what footnote arrangement penalty will be accepted without looking for a better solution.

macros.name: DefineFootnoteStack
macros.doc: This command is used for defining a footnote stack.

macros.name: footnotecarryratio
macros.doc: The fractional variable \footnotecarryratio is used for scaling the leftover material dimensions.

macros.name: FootnoteMainMinimum
macros.doc: This specifies the minimum amount of main text.

macros.name: PopFootnoteMark
macros.doc: This gets one argument, the name of the footnote stack. It pops the value of \@thefnmark from the named footnote stack.
